description: React component for the 'Show Unreads Category' setting in user sidebar preferences, allowing toggling grouping of unread channels.

classes.name: ShowUnreadsCategory
classes.description: React component managing the display and interaction for the 'Show Unreads Category' setting.

methods.name: focusEditButton
methods.description: Sets focus to the minRef element.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change event for the radio inputs, updating the checked state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Saves the preference for showing the unreads category and updates the section.

methods.name: renderDescription
methods.description: Returns the description message based on whether the unreads category is enabled.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders either a minimized or maximized setting item based on active state.
